title: Welding Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Welding Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

Project Information

JSA ID: WELD-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

WELDING TYPE: ☐ SMAW ☐ GMAW ☐ GTAW ☐ FCAW MATERIAL: ______________

LOCATION: ______________ WELDER: ______________ FIRE WATCH: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Area Preparation-Flammable materials
-Combustible fumes
-Confined space		-Fire
-Explosion		20 (VERY HIGH)-Clear area of combustibles 35' radius
-Cover floor with fire blanket
-Position fire extinguisher nearby
-Check for fuel/chemical lines
-Test for flammable atmosphere
2. Equipment Setup-Gas leaks
-Damaged cables
-Improper connections		-Fire
-Explosion
-Electrocution
-Flash fire		15 (HIGH)-Check all hoses for damage
-Test for leaks with soap solution
-Inspect electrode holder
-Secure gas cylinders
-Keep caps on when moving
3. Personal Protection-UV/IR radiation
-Sparks
-Fumes
-Noise		-Arc eye
-Skin burns
-Metal fume fever
-Hearing loss		16 (HIGH)-Wear welding helmet with proper shade
-Use leather welding jacket
-Wear welding gloves
-Use respiratory protection
-Wear hearing protection
4. Welding Operation-Electric shock
-Fumes/gases
-Hot metal
-Slag spatter		-Death
-Respiratory illness
-Burns
-Eye injury		20 (VERY HIGH)-Insulate from work surface
-Use local exhaust ventilation
-Mark hot metal
-Position welding screens
-Wear safety glasses under hood
5. Post-Weld Cleanup-Hot surfaces
-Fire rekindle
-Slag disposal
-Sharp edges		-Burns
-Fire
-Eye injury
-Cuts		10 (MEDIUM)-Cool metal slowly
-Fire watch for 30+ minutes
-Soak slag in water
-Deburr sharp edges
-Close gas cylinder valves

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Welding Helmet (Shade #____) ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ Leather Jacket ☐ Welding Gloves
